caption:
Death isn't the end. It's a seed.
A seed goes into the dark ground looking finished, then comes up new. Paul says our bodies will be raised the same way.
Who are you hoping to see again?
#jesus #resurrection #bible #faith #christian

How can God be one and three?
One God, three persons, already loving each other before the world existed.
How would you explain the Trinity to a friend?
#jesus #trinity #bible #faith #christian

You don't need the right words to pray.
Jesus didn't teach us to start with Dear Sir. He said, Our Father.
What stops you from praying?
#jesus #prayer #bible #faith #christian

The devil's real weapon isn't fire. It's lies.
He keeps a list of your failures. Jesus already took the list and nailed it to the cross.
What lie do you hear most?
#jesus #bible #faith #christian #spiritualwarfare
